moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Kicks Off!
moments.blurb: The twin music festivals, Reading and Leeds, return from August 27-30 with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C., Chase & Status Live, and Raye.

angles.name: Main Stage Buzz
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is almost here! Who are you most hyped to see tear up the main stage this Bank Holiday weekend?

angles.name: Indie & Rock Focus
angles.copy: Fontaines D.C. and Florence + The Machine are bringing the rock to Reading & Leeds! Get ready for some serious guitar anthems. #ReadingFestival #LeedsFestival

angles.name: Pop & Dance Vibes
angles.copy: Charli XCX, Dave, and RAYE are set to light up Reading & Leeds! Expect mega pop and huge tunes. Which set are you running to?

moments.title: Creamfields 2026 Takes Over Daresbury
moments.blurb: The massive electronic dance music festival, Creamfields, runs from August 27-30 in Daresbury, featuring Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia, Martin Garrix, Disclosure (Live), Becky Hill, Carl Cox, and more.

angles.name: Dance Nation Anthem
angles.copy: Creamfields is just days away! Get ready for four days of non-stop beats with Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia, and so many more. Who's on your must-see list?

angles.name: Weekend Warm-up
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday weekend means one thing for dance fans: Creamfields! Daresbury is about to get loud.

moments.title: Premier League Season Kicks Off!
moments.blurb: The 2026/2027 Premier League football season officially begins tomorrow, Saturday, August 22nd.

angles.name: Match Day Excitement
angles.copy: The wait is over! The Premier League is back tomorrow. Who are you backing for the title this season?

moments.title: Southport Air Show Returns

angles.name: Air Show Thrills
angles.copy: Look to the skies! The Southport Air Show is back next weekend with the incredible Red Arrows. Who's heading to the coast for some high-flying action?

angles.copy: Fancy a trip across the border? The Southport Air Show promises a spectacular weekend for the whole family, with the Red Arrows performing!

moments.title: Notting Hill Carnival Bank Holiday Weekend

angles.name: Carnival Countdown

angles.name: Dance & Culture
angles.copy: From sound systems to street parades, Notting Hill Carnival is the ultimate celebration of rhythm and culture. Who's ready to dance?
